def generate_title(pkg: str, remediation: Dict[str, Any], vulns: List[Dict[
    str, Any]]) ->str:
    from_dependency = remediation['version'] if remediation['version'] else remediation['requirement']['specifier']
    vuln_count = len(vulns)
    vuln_word = 'vulnerability' if vuln_count == 1 else 'vulnerabilities'
    return f"Update {pkg} from {from_dependency} to {remediation['recommended_version']} to fix {vuln_count} {vuln_word}"
